findings.originalFinding: Readiness checked only core, SLAM and license files while required worker and attribution resources were independently served.
findings.resolution: eighthwallAvailability now iterates all five eighthwallAssets allowlist entries and requires each authorized original-byte hash check to succeed.
findings.verification: Read the current helper and route call sites. The same readiness helper is used by owner availability and preview preflight. No weakened origin, authorization or integrity gate observed.

findings.originalFinding: Ordinary Restart reinjected core SDK code and script.onload could accept a previous global XR8 before the new bootstrap completed. This was a concrete source race risk, not a reproduced physical-device failure.
findings.resolution: A configuration-keyed shared sdkBootstrap promise retains successful and failed bootstrap state. Success requires the SRI-bearing script onload plus xrloaded exposing a fresh SDK identity still installed globally. Each consumer waits with its own cancellation signal; cancellation does not remove or reinject the shared bootstrap. Failure explicitly requires a page reload.
findings.verification: Read loadAuthorizedEighthWallSdk and bootstrapEighthWallScript, including both event orderings, configuration binding, consumer abort handling and sticky failure. The prior old-global/onload acceptance and repeated core injection paths are removed for ordinary restart.

geometryConclusion.explanation: The hidden React video intrinsic width is not used for SDK tap or overlay geometry. Provider dimensions come from the SDK drawing canvas; taps undo the same centered contain fit and rays unproject the exact SDK matrix. The Scene overlay applies the matching contain transform for its displayed host viewport.
geometryConclusion.limitation: This source consistency does not verify actual Safari video/canvas dimensions, startup callback order, displayed pixels or physical ray accuracy.
